name: Isnisia
startIntroPart1: The question must be asked, what is the price of peace and security? Everything has a cost, especially survival. Armies to protect a nation cost men and weapons, which cost food and materiale, neither of which are in secure supply. The obvious answer is to secure that supply. Land and resources are abundant in the world of Unciv if you look in the right place. However, every other nation must answer the same question, and naturally, every nation will be driven to expansion. The resources of Unciv are vast but finite, there will inevitably be some who will have less power than those around them. So what will be one's answer then? Once nations are set in stone and can only advance by taking the chisel of war, one must become a stronger stone, a stone which cannot be sculpted by mere chisels. Resilience allows nations to survive even the greatest of catastrophes, to be able reforge oneself is equivalent to immortality.
startIntroPart2: Can you, IsNss, bear this cost of survival? Can you find the resilience to weather an eternal catastrophe? Can you build an empire that can withstand the test of time?
declaringWar: There are times when war is the only way forward for a nation.
afterPeace: This fire was transformative, but the next may become destructive.

name: Megacity
startIntroPart1: There are many cities in the world, defined by their culture, population, industry, location. They are all interesting and beautiful in their own right and serve to house so much people and industry in such a dense space. But does it really matter if there is one city to surpass them all?
startIntroPart2: Can you build a biggest city in Unciv history? Can you maintain a megalopolis throughout all the eras? Can this Megacity stand the test of time?
declaringWar: There can only be one city.
tradeRequest: More for the greatest city in the world, the Megacity!

name: Cytosia
startIntroPart1: From the loam you were born, only knowing of the water in the soil. By fate or by coincidence you came into contact with humanity. They were suprisingly kind, granting you what they considered waste. You festered and grew, hiding in their manure until you learnt their language and way of life; Within it a bounty of imagination and ingenuity. Oh what a wonderful taste is man's psyche! It is so delectable you must find and consume more! Though even with such a wonderful vessel, be wary of your own basal anatomy, for you cannot handle the hot, cold, and dry.
startIntroPart2: You, your territory and name granted by the self proclaimed vanguard of humanity, has had a taste of consciousness and has now developed an insatiable hunger for it. Throughout the annals of time, your heart calls: 'Consume! Multiply! Proliferate!'

name: The Xiseyu
startIntroPart1: Your mothers and fathers told you of the curse your species bears. The spiteful deity has hunted the Xiseyu for trillions of years across several realities for the crime of communal immortality. The closer it becomes the stronger their souls decay. The Xiseyu have come to cope by travelling from reality to reality, using the resources of whatever planet they find themselves on. This one is among the thousands your forefathers have visited.
startIntroPart2: You arrive with tattered knowledge of the universe your forebearers held and exactly 5700 years before that spiteful deity arrives in full force. Can you lead this generation of entropic refugee fugitives to live another day? Can this civilization continue to cheat the test of time?
